title: Eco-friendly differential pulse voltammetric determination of benzydamine hydrochloride using a gold nanoparticles-modified carbon paste electrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24539-24550
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02390H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maryam A. Bakr, Samah S. Abbas, Maha A. Hegazy, Amr M. Badawey, Sally S. El-Mosallamy
A differential pulse voltammetric (DPV) method using carbon paste electrode decorated with gold nanoparticles is presented for the determination of benzydamine hydrochloride (BZ) in bulk powder, mouthwash formulation, and artificial saliva matrices.
